inputs.text: This is what a protected arrangement looks like: illegal mining continues while the Congress government is accused of looking away. KTR says the company is linked to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, and the effort to manage the story feels less like clarification than containment. The allegation may not be the whole picture—which makes the silence and distraction around it all the more suspicious. When powerful interests stand to benefit, the official narrative can be part of the protection.
